challenge.method: Parsed both tag objects and matched their target commits to the raw capture URLs. Decoded SPDX licenseText, split the publisher text into the disclaimer, grant and three conditions, and checked each passage separately after collapsing whitespace. Inspected the surrounding notice, title and template fields for differences the comparison omitted.
challenge.results: Both targets matched and all five passages matched in order. SPDX adds a license title, uses different wrapping, indentation and paragraph spacing, and omits the dated author notice and contact block from licenseText. Its separate template permits a variable copyright field and bullet formatting. Treating the SPDX rendering as a byte-identical publisher file, or using it as a substitute for the actual source notice, would exceed the evidence. No operative contradiction was found.

limitations: SPDX is primary authority for its own identifier and listing. The repeated terms have shared textual lineage and supply no independent corroboration of the publisher’s grant.
